title: Good Quality; attractive, easy to assemble
text: Good Quality; attractive, easy to assemble. Unlike so much of the furniture you can buy these days, this is not made out of cheap particle board.  This is real wood; a decent quality veneer.  Assembly was easy and the color and appearance looks great.  Drawer glides are wooden also, so not too much chance of breaking.  I have seen furniture with plastic drawer glides that are stapled on and they already break.  The glides and made into the drawers and the sides, so no chance of breaking.  Worth the money.
